scripts.check:control-flow: if grep -rnE '\*ngIf|\*ngFor|\*ngSwitch|\*ngSwitchCase|\*ngSwitchDefault' src --include='*.html'; then echo 'Use Angular control flow syntax only: @if/@for/@switch.' && exit 1; else echo 'Angular control flow check passed.'; fi
scripts.check:template-bindings: if grep -rnE '\[ngClass\]|\[ngStyle\]' src --include='*.html' --include='*.ts'; then echo 'Use native class/style bindings only.' && exit 1; else echo 'Template binding check passed.'; fi
scripts.check:rtl-logical: if (grep -rnE '\b(pl-|pr-|ml-|mr-|left-|right-|border-l\b|border-r\b)' src --include='*.html' --include='*.ts' --include='*.scss' | grep -v '\.spec\.ts:' || grep -rnE '\b(margin-left|margin-right|padding-left|padding-right|border-left\b|border-right\b)\s*:' src --include='*.html' --include='*.ts' --include='*.scss' | grep -v '\.spec\.ts:'); then echo 'Use logical direction utilities only: ps/pe/ms/me/border-s/border-e or CSS logical properties (margin-inline-start, margin-inline-end, etc.).' && exit 1; else echo 'RTL logical class check passed.'; fi
scripts.check:spartan-health: npm run check:spartan-config && npm run check:spartan-info && npm run check:spartan-healthcheck
scripts.lint: eslint "src/**/*.ts" --fix && npm run check:control-flow && npm run check:template-bindings && npm run check:rtl-logical && npm run check:relay-token-ownership && npm run check:multilingual-typography && npm run check:semantic-colour-roles && npm run check:surface-elevation && npm run check:radius-hierarchy && npm run check:spacing-density && npm run check:motion-contract && npm run check:icon-contract && npm run check:density-modes && npm run check:forced-colors
